title: add release manifests, cosign signing, syft SBOMs and provenance for private-installer nightly builds
author: Priya Desai
description:
Context: private-installer releases must be reproducible, auditable, and verifiable for customers running in VPC/on-prem. This PR wires release manifests and provenance artifacts into the private-installer nightly and release pipelines so every installer build publishes: 1) a release-manifest (yaml) describing artifacts and versions, 2) cosign signatures for release artifacts (tarballs, helm charts, container images), 3) syft-generated SBOMs (json) for images and tarballs, and 4) provenance attestations (in-toto/rekor-friendly) that link build inputs to outputs.

What this PR does: 
- Adds CI workflow .github/workflows/release-private-installer.yml that produces release-manifests and drives signing and SBOM generation.
- Adds scripts/ci/sign-artifacts.sh and scripts/ci/generate-sbom.sh to standardize cosign+syft usage across pipelines.
- Publishes release-manifests to storage (s3/GCS) and attaches SHA256 / signed attestations.
- Updates charts/private-installer/Chart.yaml and packaging/Makefile to emit chart tarballs with provenance metadata.
- Pins syft and cosign versions in tools/ci-versions.toml for repeatability.
- Adds terraform/modules/private-installer/versions.tf update to record released module tags as part of the manifest.
- Adds simple verification helper scripts in tooling/verify-release.sh that customers/operators can run to validate signatures and SBOMs before install.

Motivation: customers running in regulated environments require signed artifacts and SBOMs to satisfy supply-chain audits. This work reduces manual steps in our release process and provides machine-readable provenance for customers who want to verify builds.

Checklist: 
- [x] CI workflow to produce release-manifests
- [x] Cosign signing integration + key retrieval (KMS/HSM support left as opt-in)
- [x] Syft-based SBOM generation for images and tarballs
- [x] Release manifest schema and examples under build/release-manifests/
- [x] Verification helpers and docs under docs/release/
- [x] Tests: unit for scripts + integration run in ephemeral pipeline (recorded run)

Upgrade/rollback notes: release-manifests include explicit artifact versions and previous-release pointers; verify-release.sh supports fallback verification against previous manifests which enables safe rollback to a known-good artifact set. The pipeline also tags artifacts with a provenance:previous tag so rollbacks are traceable.

How to validate locally: follow docs/release/README.md -> scripts/ci/generate-sbom.sh ./path/to/tar -> produce sbom.json and run scripts/ci/sign-artifacts.sh --artifact build/my-installer.tar --key <cosign-key> -> inspect build/release-manifests/latest.yaml and run tooling/verify-release.sh --manifest build/release-manifests/latest.yaml

Notes: KMS/HSM integration uses environment-backed key fetch; production signing keys are not stored in the repo. The PR includes a CI-mode that uses ephemeral test keys for CI testing only.

Related: ENG-4122 (supply chain hardening), DEVOPS-318 (release automation improvements).

release_notes: Adds release manifests, SBOM generation (syft), cosign signing, and provenance attestations for private-installer builds. CI workflows now publish signed artifacts and machine-readable manifests to storage. Includes verification tooling and docs for operators to validate releases. (ENG-4122, DEVOPS-318)
